name: smwmusic-rockfish-unreleased-life-on-the-ship
title: Rockfish (Unreleased) - Life on the Ship
description:
A calm, but upbeat theme from a later version of Rockfish, where you control a human, instead of a fish.
This game was being developed by Pixel, the same person who made Cave Story and Kero Blaster, and then was cancelled in 2012, in order to work on other projects at the time.
Until then, he never talked about it, when after recently, he started posting about this game again on twitter, and then, posted this cute little song, in which I felt like porting it.

It does uses the KSS's soundfont.
